title: GRIFFO - Dependencies
description: GRIFFO is a bridge mod between Essential and EMF that fixes an animation conflict: when Essential plays an emote, GRIFFO automatically pauses Fresh Animations for its duration and resumes it when it ends.
body:
# GRIFFO

**[English]**

GRIFFO is a bridge mod between Essential and EMF (Entity Model Features) that automatically resolves an animation conflict between the two mods.

When Essential plays an emote, EMF blocks the player's animation, causing visual glitches. GRIFFO silently detects when an emote is active, temporarily pauses Fresh Animations for its duration, and seamlessly resumes them once the emote ends — no configuration needed.

✔ Automatic detection

✔ No configuration required

✔ Fully compatible with Fresh Animations

---

**[Español]**

GRIFFO es un mod puente entre Essential y EMF (Entity Model Features) que resuelve automáticamente un conflicto de animaciones entre ambos mods.

Cuando Essential reproduce un emote, EMF bloquea la animación del jugador, causando errores visuales. GRIFFO detecta silenciosamente cuándo un emote está activo, pausa temporalmente Fresh Animations mientras dura, y las reanuda sin interrupciones al terminar — sin necesidad de configuración.

✔ Detección automática

✔ Sin configuración necesaria

✔ Totalmente compatible con Fresh Animations
